card.name: Inside diabetic and neutropenic terms
card.fires_on: The pole responds partway through the words diabetic and neutropenia/neutrophilic, as in Diabetic Macular Edema, diabetic ketoacidosis and Febrile Neutropenic. It also responds once to a space after a date.

modes.label: Diabetic
modes.description: The word diabetic, or its middle piece, in condition names such as macular edema, retinopathy or ketoacidosis.

modes.label: Neutropenia terms
modes.description: The middle of neutropenic, neutrophilic or neutropenia, after Febrile or Ne.
